name: AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems & Tool Orchestration
description: Autonomous LLM agents, cognitive architectures, function calling and tool use, ReAct execution loops, memory systems (short-term, long-term, semantic, episodic), multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), human-in-the-loop (HITL), and task planning.

subskills.name: Function Calling & Tool Schema Definitions
subskills.description: Defining tools and JSON schemas for LLM function calling (OpenAI tools parameter, Pydantic tool definitions, LangChain @tool decorator), parameter validation, and local execution.

subskills.name: ReAct Agent Loop & Thought-Action-Observation
subskills.description: Implementing and debugging the ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop: Thought -> Action -> Action Input -> Observation -> Final Answer cycle, handling parsing errors and infinite loops.

subskills.name: Agent Conversational & Working Memory
subskills.description: Managing agent short-term and working memory: ConversationBufferMemory, ConversationSummaryMemory, sliding window token limiters, and structured scratchpad state.

subskills.name: Stateful Agent Graphs with LangGraph
subskills.description: Building cyclical, stateful agent graphs using LangGraph: StateGraph, TypedDict state schema, Nodes, conditional Edges, state persistence (MemorySaver, SqliteSaver checkpointer), and time travel.

subskills.name: Role-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration (CrewAI)
subskills.description: Orchestrating multi-agent systems with CrewAI: Agent definitions (role, goal, backstory, verbose), Task assignments, Processes (Sequential, Hierarchical with Manager LLM), and inter-agent delegation.

subskills.name: Conversable Multi-Agent Systems (AutoGen & AG2)
subskills.description: Developing conversable multi-agent architectures using Microsoft AutoGen / AG2: AssistantAgent, UserProxyAgent, GroupChatManager, sandboxed Docker code execution, and termination conditions.

subskills.name: Hierarchical Task Planning & Subgoal Decomposition
subskills.description: Implementing hierarchical planning and goal decomposition: Plan-and-Solve prompting, dynamic DAG task generation, dependency resolution, failure recovery, and replanning.

subskills.name: Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) Workflows & Approval Gates
subskills.description: Designing enterprise Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) safety workflows: interrupt patterns before high-stakes tool execution (e.g. database mutations, payment triggers), resume tokens, and state inspection.

subskills.name: Long-Term Episodic & Semantic Memory (MemGPT / Letta)
subskills.description: Implementing long-term agent memory architectures: MemGPT / Letta tiered memory (core memory, recall memory, archival memory), episodic experience retrieval, and self-editing user profiles.
